name: Postgres scheduled-export runner
purpose: The scheduled export runner that drives pg_dump against the live database, writes the artefact to the elicited destination, and emits backupExported with the artefact path and completion timestamp. Pairs with the deploy target's own point-in-time recovery on ADR-2804; the runner covers the portable-artefact half of the two-path recovery model.
responsibilities: Invoke pg_dump via child_process.execFile against the elicited connection URL with an elicited pg_dump argument set (default: --no-owner --no-acl --format=plain) (AC-27105-1).
Stream the pg_dump stdout to a temporary file, atomically rename to the elicited destination path (a filesystem path in the shipped fixture; an operator-owned path in production) (AC-27105-1).
On successful completion, emit backupExported on the injected event sink with { artefactPath, completedAt } (AC-27105-1).
On pg_dump non-zero exit, emit backupExportFailed with the exit code and stderr tail, delete the partial temp file, exit non-zero.
Cadence is elicited (a cron string, a systemd timer spec, or off for CI-only invocation); the runner does not schedule itself; a project-side scheduler invokes it.
internalStructure: One Node module exporting an exportDatabase({ connectionUrl, destination, onEvent, pgDumpArgs }) async function. The module resolves pg_dump on PATH via child_process.execFile, streams stdout to a temp file inside the destination's directory, and atomically renames on success. The recovery-drill helper in the same module invokes exportDatabase, brings up a fresh Postgres via docker compose or podman, streams the artefact into psql, and compares row-count and checksum on both databases.

interfaces.name: exportDatabase
interfaces.description: await exportDatabase({ connectionUrl, destination, onEvent, pgDumpArgs }) -> { artefactPath, completedAt }. Runs pg_dump, writes the artefact, fires backupExported.

interfaces.name: recoveryDrill
interfaces.description: await recoveryDrill({ sourceUrl, destination, onEvent }) -> { count, checksum }. Runs exportDatabase, primes a fresh Postgres from the artefact, compares row-count and checksum on the fixture table, fires recoveryDrillPassed.

dependencies.name: Postgres facade
dependencies.description: Shares the facade's event sink for backupExported and recoveryDrillPassed.

tradeoffs: child_process.execFile against pg_dump requires the pg_dump binary to be on PATH (or a full path passed via config). On a container platform the runner ships a Postgres client image alongside the app for pg_dump availability; the guide names the CI-seam pattern. The runner does not implement WAL-shipping or a streaming backup; that path is the deploy target's own PITR obligation on ADR-2804.
